tasks.setting:
The maps show the layout of a town park in 2000 and in 2020. They indicate the positions of its principal facilities and the road on its southern edge. The two maps cover the same area, and north is at the top of each.

2000                         2020
             N                            N
             ↑                            ↑
Pond          | Flower beds    Pond         | Playground
-------------+------------    ------------+------------
Café          | Toilets        Café         | Toilets
-------------+------------    ------------+------------
Lawn          | Entrance       Sports court | Entrance
========== South Road ======   ======== South Road ======
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括主要变化和保留项目，按区域说明设施的位置与改建关系。
tasks.model:
The maps compare the layout of a town park in 2000 and 2020, showing its main facilities and the road along its southern boundary.

Overall, the park retained its entrance, pond, café and toilets, but two open areas were converted into facilities for play and sport. The road continued to run along the south side of the site.

In the northern part of the park, the pond remained in the north-western corner. To its east, however, the flower beds that existed in 2000 had been replaced by a playground by 2020. The two facilities occupied the corresponding northern positions on either side of the central dividing line.

Further south, the café and toilets were unchanged. The café was situated on the western side, with the toilets opposite it to the east. The lawn in the south-west underwent another change: a sports court occupied its former position in 2020. In the south-east, the entrance stayed beside South Road, as it had been in 2000.

tasks.setting:
The maps show the present layout of a college site and a plan for its redevelopment. They identify the principal buildings and open spaces, together with the road on the southern boundary. Both maps cover the same site and have north at the top.

Present                       Plan
             N                            N
             ↑                            ↑
Library       | Garden         Library      | Laboratory
-------------+------------    ------------+------------
Hall          | Office         Hall         | Office
-------------+------------    ------------+------------
Car park      | Entrance       Sports field | Entrance
========== College Road ====   ======== College Road ===
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括主要变化和保留项目，按区域说明设施的位置与改建关系。
tasks.model:
The maps illustrate the current arrangement of a college site and the proposed layout after redevelopment. They show the main buildings and open spaces in relation to College Road, which runs along the southern edge.

Overall, the plan involves replacing two open areas with new facilities, while the existing principal buildings and the entrance are to remain in their present positions. The road is also retained.

At present, the library is in the north-west of the site, with a garden to its east. Under the plan, the library will remain where it is, but the garden will make way for a laboratory in the north-east. In the middle of the site, the hall on the western side and the office opposite it on the eastern side are both unchanged.

The second alteration concerns the south-western area. The existing car park is to be replaced by a sports field. To the east of this, the entrance will continue to provide access from College Road. Thus the changes are concentrated in the north-eastern and south-western parts of the site.
